jobs.continued_gpu: GPU continuation granted; iOS can still pause or end this task.
jobs.continued_cpu: CPU continuation granted; iOS can still pause or end this task.
jobs.switching_cpu: Saving progress and releasing the GPU before continuing on CPU…
jobs.background_limited: Background time is limited by iOS. Completed steps are saved if time expires.
jobs.background_requestable: This phone supports background GPU requests. Each task still needs iOS approval.
jobs.gpu_unavailable: Background GPU is unavailable here. Use CPU continuation or reopen to resume saved steps.
jobs.cpu_fallback: Allow CPU continuation when background GPU is unavailable
jobs.cpu_tradeoff: CPU continuation is slower and may use more battery. Foreground work normally uses the GPU.
jobs.cpu_unavailable: CPU continuation is unavailable for this model in the installed build. Saved steps can still resume in the foreground.
jobs.foreground_service: A foreground service keeps this task running while Android allows it.
